data.title: Australian AI and backup PC builds
data.introduction: Compare a staged Ryzen tower with complete local AI options. Every build uses the same usable storage capacity, UPS and separate recovery drive.
data.price_basis: Prices as listed on 13 November 2026. Delivery and invoice details are confirmed at checkout.
data.totals_exclude: Totals exclude delivery, assembly, rental, electricity, ongoing cloud fees, payment surcharges and any extra controllers, trays, cables or cooling.
data.unverified: Exact RAM kit and BIOS compatibility, final mechanical fit, loaded thermals, GPU passthrough, UPS shutdown and an independent restore have not been verified.
data.capacity_note: Each build has two 16TB HDDs mirrored for about 16TB usable and two 2TB SSDs mirrored for about 2TB usable, before overhead and reserve. The separate 20TB drive holds a recovery copy. Size backup storage to allow for retention, and keep the verified copy disconnected or off-site.

builds.name: Value base, GPU later
builds.main_tradeoff: Lowest initial cost; secondary long slots run at PCIe 3.0 x1.
builds.upgrade_path: Add one dedicated GPU in the main CPU slot. More than four SATA devices needs a qualified controller and a suitable slot.
builds.verification: Sourced planning comparison; no assembled-system, hardware or workload test

builds.name: Expansion base, GPU later
builds.main_tradeoff: A$570 above the value base for stronger card expansion and faster networking; no dedicated GPU is included.
builds.upgrade_path: Two CPU-connected graphics slots can run at x8/x8; M.2_2 changes the second slot to x4. Qualify card spacing, PSU capacity, cooling and software before adding cards.
builds.verification: Sourced planning comparison; no assembled-system, hardware or workload test

builds.name: Balanced local AI, Radeon 32GB
builds.main_tradeoff: Lower-priced standalone 32GB GPU in this sample; the AMD runtime and chosen model need a supported OS and a workload trial.
builds.upgrade_path: The second long expansion slot suitable for a controller runs at chipset x4. Keep M.2_2 and its USB4 sharing in mind when adding SSDs.
builds.verification: Sourced planning comparison; no assembled-system, hardware or workload test

builds.name: Expansion local AI, Radeon 32GB
builds.main_tradeoff: A$350 above the balanced build for two-card lane options and 10GbE; model performance is unmeasured.
builds.upgrade_path: A second card can use the x8/x8 path if M.2_2 is kept free. Two cards do not automatically pool VRAM; software, thermals and power need qualification.
builds.verification: Sourced planning comparison; no assembled-system, hardware or workload test

builds.name: Expansion local AI, NVIDIA 32GB
builds.main_tradeoff: CUDA and ECC memory cost A$4,100 more than the Radeon in the same build; workload benefit is unmeasured.
builds.upgrade_path: The same x8/x8 expansion path is available, with the M.2_2 trade-off. Future GPU and multi-GPU support depend on the exact runtime and workload.
builds.verification: Sourced planning comparison; no assembled-system, hardware or workload test
